name: ORT-Bert-Benchmark
description: A benchmarking dataset that focuses on BERT model performance under ONNX Runtime (ORT) configurations. It provides inference metrics (latency, throughput) and accuracy measurements across hardware and optimization settings to support evaluation and optimization of BERT deployments. The dataset is intended for practitioners measuring trade-offs between speed and predictive quality.
reputation: A practical, practitioner-oriented benchmark for evaluating BERT inference (ORT) performance, used mainly in systems/ML optimization work rather than broad model comparison.
